description: In the update echo path (chat.rs:461, space.rs:456), when update_object returns Ok(Some(obj)), the code does serde_json::to_value(&obj).unwrap_or(Value::Null). If serialization fails, the entry is silently inserted as null — indistinguishable from Ok(None) (no server-side modifications). The correct behavior mirrors the create path: unwrap_or_else(|e| json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": e.to_string()})). With derived Serialize the error is near-impossible in practice, but the fallback semantics are wrong and will mislead future readers about what null means in the updated map. mailbox.rs uses .and_then(|o| serde_json::to_value(o).ok()).unwrap_or(Value::Null) — equally wrong. All update echo paths should use the create-side error-surfacing pattern.
title: update echo: serde_json::to_value(&obj).unwrap_or(Value::Null) silently swallows serialization error
